examples.description: Put a soft drop shadow under a cut-out on a white backdrop. Replace the asset keys with asset_key values from your own earlier image results.

description: Add a product shadow to a cut-out (subject on transparency), cast from its alpha: kind drop, contact or reflection. angle 0..359 is the light direction counterclockwise from 3 o'clock (default 120; the shadow falls the other way); distance 0..200 px (default 12; the gap under the base for a reflection); blur 0..100 px (default 16); opacity 0..100 (default 50); transparent true (default) keeps the backdrop see-through, false fills background #RRGGBB (default #ffffff) behind the shadow. contact ignores angle and distance, reflection ignores angle. The result grows past the input by the shadow's reach (distance plus blur) so no visible shadow pixel is cut: output pad {left, top, right, bottom} gives the growth in input pixels and subject_box the subject in the result; clipped true means the growth was trimmed to stay within 4,194,304 pixels. Free: runs on the platform's own deterministic kernel, so the same input and arguments always return the same pixels. Takes PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF or HEIC. Returns JSON {images:[{url, asset_key, download_url?, width, height}], price, next} plus a preview; images are stored in this workspace. Refuses: SIMPLER_MEDIA_INPUT_MISSING (pass the url or the asset_key), SIMPLER_MEDIA_FOREIGN_KEY (use this workspace's asset_key), SIMPLER_MEDIA_URL_REFUSED (use https, data:image or an asset_key), SIMPLER_MEDIA_PIN_TOO_LARGE (under 20MB), SIMPLER_EDIT_SHADOW_NEEDS_CUTOUT (no transparent pixels: run image.cut_background and pass its asset_key), VALIDATION_ERROR with reason SIMPLER_EDIT_TOOL_ARGS_INVALID for a value out of range, SIMPLER_EDIT_SERVER_PIXELS_NEEDS_PNG (the file is not an image: send a PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF or HEIC), SIMPLER_EDIT_SERVER_PIXELS_TOO_LARGE (at most 4,194,304 pixels: run image.convert with width and height 2048 first), SIMPLER_IMAGES_BINDING_ABSENT (this deployment has no Images binding yet, owner step O-2: send a standard PNG), SIMPLER_IMAGES_QUOTA_EXCEEDED or SIMPLER_IMAGES_LEGACY_SUBSCRIPTION (an owner account step: send a standard PNG meanwhile), SIMPLER_IMAGES_INPUT_UNREADABLE (send a PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF or HEIC), SIMPLER_IMAGES_INPUT_TOO_LARGE (under 20,000,000 bytes and 100 megapixels), SIMPLER_IMAGES_TRANSFORM_FAILED (retry, or send a standard PNG); nothing is charged on any of them, and INSUFFICIENT_CREDITS or PAYMENT_REQUIRED only when the workspace is already overdrawn or past its spend cap (add credits or raise the cap). NEXT: pass images[0].asset_key as image_asset_key to the next image.* tool, or open download_url when the result carries one.

angle.description: Light direction in degrees, counterclockwise from 3 o'clock (default 120).

background.description: #RRGGBB backdrop used when transparent is false (default #ffffff). The word transparent is also accepted and means transparent true; it cannot be combined with transparent false.

image_asset_key.description: Cut-out subject on transparency, as the asset_key of an earlier image result for this workspace (edit-projects/<tenant>/... or images/<tenant>/...). A key from another workspace is refused (SIMPLER_MEDIA_FOREIGN_KEY).

image_url.description: Cut-out subject on transparency: a public https URL, a data:image/...;base64 URL, or the url/url_path of an earlier image result (max 20MB; PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF; SVG is refused). Pass this or the matching *_asset_key, not both.

preview_format.description: Preview block after the JSON, at most 384px on the long edge and never charged: png, jpeg or none. Left out, a PNG result gets a png preview and a JPEG or WebP result a jpeg one. A result with no preview says why in preview_unavailable.

request_ref.description: Optional idempotency key (1-64 chars: letters, digits, . _ : -). Retrying with the same request_ref and the same arguments within 24 hours returns the first result at $0 with replayed: true; the same request_ref with different arguments is refused (SIMPLER_IMAGE_REQUEST_REF_CONFLICT), and so is a retry whose first result was deleted since (SIMPLER_IMAGE_REQUEST_REF_RESULT_DELETED): send a new request_ref to run it again.

transparent.description: true (default) keeps the backdrop see-through; false fills background behind the shadow.

name: image.add_shadow
